ab_workload.long: long-tool, long-think; seed 1; one write_file content with 256 explicit numbered lines; 2048 max tokens each; SSE server timings
ab_workload.cold: original tool request immediately after warmup; seed 1; cache_prompt=false
ab_workload.short: 2 sequential agent follow-ups; cache_prompt=true; 768 max tokens
ab_workload.steady_gate: at least 40 adjacent full-K interior SSE intervals and 2048 completion tokens per long request; visible write_file arguments; validate after all boot requests are recorded
ab_workload.fixed_cost: report prompt, generation excess, and outside prompt/generation separately
